about: Laurea's venue database. Each venue's reviewer form, recommendation scale and reviewer policy, taken from the venue's own guidelines where they are public. 'form' is 'published' when the scale and fields come from the venue's own pages, 'partial' when the venue does not publish its form and the scale follows its recent practice, and 'generic' for the general-purpose entries. Recommendation, score and confidence options are listed best first. Each option's tone (accept, borderline, revise or reject) drives the editor's colours. Form fields map the review's sections (summary, strengths, weaknesses, questions, changes_major, changes_moderate, changes_minor, limitations, ethics) onto the venue's own form, for copying into the submission system. Add venues here in future releases; ids never change.

policy.text: NeurIPS 2026 lets reviewers use only its own sanctioned assistant in OpenReview, and only on papers where that is allowed. Its confidentiality rules say not to share submissions with any unsanctioned LLM.

policy.text: ICML 2026 assigns each reviewer an LLM policy per paper. Under Policy A any LLM use is prohibited; under Policy B, privacy-compliant LLMs may help you understand the paper and polish the review, but judgement and critique must not be delegated. The Position Paper Track is always Policy A.

policy.text: IJCAI lets reviewers use generative AI only to improve the readability of their reports, after removing anything that identifies the submission. Uploading confidential submissions to a third-party system, including LLMs, that does not promise confidentiality is not allowed.
